entity.summary: Seychelles-registered centralized cryptocurrency exchange operating since 2018, with spot and derivatives markets. It announced regional service wind-downs in the Netherlands and France in 2026 and faces a FinCEN special measure and Binance counterparty transfer restrictions.
entity.notes: Official company material and an independent exchange profile support the 2018 operating year and continuing service. Regional offboarding establishes limited status; MEXC stated on November 7 that it continued operating. No global closure or insolvency is established. The December 10 U.S. order effective date and March 5, 2027 France withdrawal cutoff are scheduled, not confirmed completed.

expected.summary: Seychelles-based centralized exchange launched in 2018 and still operating under the MEXC brand.
expected.notes: Official MEXC materials state that the exchange has operated since 2018.

events.title: MEXC began operating
events.description: MEXC began operating as a centralized cryptocurrency exchange in 2018.
events.notes: Year-level launch marker because the official company page states the operating year without an exact public day.

events.title: Hong Kong's SFC warned against unlicensed MEXC activity
events.description: Hong Kong's Securities and Futures Commission warned that MEXC was actively promoting virtual-asset trading services to Hong Kong investors without a licence application and added it to the Suspicious Virtual Asset Trading Platforms Alert List.
events.notes: The warning was jurisdiction-specific and did not establish a global shutdown or alter MEXC's active entity status.

events.title: MEXC announced Netherlands service wind-down
events.description: MEXC announced phased offboarding of Netherlands-linked users in response to EEA regulatory developments. The stated final batch completion was October 31, 2026.
events.notes: Scope is Netherlands-linked accounts. The notice includes earlier batches and does not establish a global closure.

events.title: MEXC announced France service wind-down
events.description: MEXC announced phased offboarding of France-linked users through March 5, 2027. The first batch was scheduled to enter reduced-service mode on November 18, 2026 (UTC+1).
events.notes: Scheduled restrictions and final withdrawal cutoff are not confirmed completed events. Regional wind-down predates the November 6 FinCEN order.

events.title: MEXC announced Netherlands remaining-asset custody arrangements
events.description: MEXC announced that remaining assets for affected Netherlands users would be held in custody with Kraken after offboarding, with unsupported assets converted to USDC as applicable.
events.notes: Custody transfer was scheduled for November 16; actual completion is not independently verified. No acquisition or merger is implied.

events.title: FinCEN issued special measure targeting MEXC Global
events.description: FinCEN designated MEXC Global a primary money laundering concern and issued an order restricting covered U.S. financial institutions' transfers involving it. The order was published November 10 with a December 10 effective date. MEXC stated on November 7 that it continued operating and was reviewing the order.
events.notes: The agency's findings are attributed to FinCEN. The order does not itself establish global shutdown, insolvency or loss of customer assets.

events.title: Binance restricted transfers involving MEXC and affiliates
events.description: Binance announced that transfers to designated MEXC entities would be rejected and incoming funds withheld pending compliance review. Direct and indirect transactions involving the listed entities are covered.
events.notes: Counterparty-specific restriction, not a global suspension of all deposits or withdrawals at MEXC. Separate from the December 10 effective date of the U.S. order.
